description: Source code for the 'kyaml' package, providing YAML encoding and decoding functionalities with custom formatting, including multi-document support, string escaping, and YAML node rendering.

classes.name: Encoder
classes.description: A struct that formats objects or YAML data into KYAML, supporting options like compact formatting.

methods.name: FromYAML
methods.description: Renders a KYAML (multi-)document from YAML bytes, including the KYAML header.

methods.name: FromObject
methods.description: Renders a KYAML document from a Go object, including the header.

methods.name: Marshal
methods.description: Serializes a single Go object into KYAML bytes without header or trailing newline.

methods.name: fromObjectYAML
methods.description: Helper that renders a YAML node to KYAML format.

methods.name: flags
methods.description: Returns encoding options as a bitmask.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Processes a YAML node, calling specific render functions based on node type.

methods.name: renderDocument
methods.description: Renders a YAML document node, including comments and separators.

methods.name: renderScalar
methods.description: Renders a scalar YAML node, handling different tags.

methods.name: renderString
methods.description: Renders a string with proper escaping, quoting, and formatting.

methods.name: appendEscapedRune
methods.description: Appends an escaped representation of a rune to a buffer, considering YAML escaping rules.

methods.name: renderSequence
methods.description: Renders a sequence node, choosing between compact and expanded formats.

methods.name: renderCuddledSequence
methods.description: Renders a sequence in cuddled (inline) format.

methods.name: renderUncuddledSequence
methods.description: Renders a sequence in expanded, multi-line format.

methods.name: renderMapping
methods.description: Renders a mapping node, including comments and formatting options.

methods.name: renderCompactMapping
methods.description: Renders a mapping in compact form.

methods.name: writeIndent
methods.description: Writes indentation spaces to the output.

methods.name: renderComments
methods.description: Outputs comment blocks with proper indentation.

methods.name: renderAlias
methods.description: Renders an alias node if present.
